product.name: WebCited
product.description: WebCited is a platform that does a complete end-to-end analysis of your website across AI answer engines. We scan your entire site against ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot to build a complete citation map — showing exactly where you're being cited, mentioned, or ignored. Then we surface targeted opportunities to improve your AI visibility and track how those changes perform over time. First scan is free, no card required. Any website that wants to be found in AI answers is a fit.
product.genre: AI search visibility / AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) — helps any website show up in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot answers

targeting.idealProspect: Anyone and everyone launching a product — every new launch wants visibility and buyers discover tools through AI search engines. Every product with a website is a fit.
